metadata.title: Arab Futures Society
metadata.description: Exploring and shaping the future of the Arab world through foresight and collaborative knowledge.

hero.title: Arab Futures Society
hero.slogan: A collaborative platform for building a shared lexicon of future-oriented concepts in the Arab world.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the leading platform for future studies and foresight in the Arab world, fostering a community of thinkers and doers.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To build a shared, open-source lexicon of future-oriented concepts, enabling richer dialogue and collaborative action.

features.label: Research & Analysis
features.heading: Deep Dives into Future Trends
features.description: We systematically identify, analyze, and synthesize emerging trends relevant to the Arab world, from technological shifts to social dynamics.

features.label: Community & Collaboration
features.heading: Building a Network of Futurists
features.description: We facilitate workshops, discussions, and collaborative projects to build a vibrant community dedicated to foresight.

about.title: About the Society
about.p1: We are a collective of researchers, designers, and futurists dedicated to fostering a proactive and imaginative approach to the future within the Arab world.
about.breakoutDescription: Language shapes thought. By building a shared, nuanced vocabulary for future concepts, we empower clearer communication, deeper understanding, and more effective collaboration on the challenges and opportunities ahead.

collaboration.label: Collaboration
collaboration.value: We believe in the power of collective intelligence to build richer knowledge.

openness.label: Openness
openness.value: Our work is open-source and accessible to all, encouraging broad participation.

rigor.label: Intellectual Rigor
rigor.value: We are committed to high-quality, well-researched, and contextually relevant content.

foresight.label: Proactive Foresight
foresight.value: We aim to move beyond reaction and actively shape a desirable future.

features.heading: The Futures Lexicon
features.label: Ongoing Project
features.description: Our primary initiative is the creation of a comprehensive, bilingual (Arabic/English), open-source lexicon of terms related to future studies, technology, and societal transformation. It serves as a foundational tool for researchers, policymakers, and the public.

featuredTerms.title: Featured Terms
featuredTerms.description: Explore our curated collection of key concepts and ideas.
